description: Quality audit 2026-05-21 using cognitive-load-reduction found material local-readability drift in the vrooli-events UI selector/testing surface. Evidence: scenarios/vrooli-events/ui/src/consts/selectors.ts is 373 lines and implements a scenario-local generic selector framework: recursive literal and dynamic selector trees, ParamSchema/ParamValueType conditional typing, normalizeParams validation, flattenLiteralSelectors, flattenDynamicSelectors, mergeLiteralAndDynamicNodes, createDynamicSelectorFn, and createSelectorRegistry. The actual dynamic surface is only two event-table selectors (rowByIndex and rowByEventId), while most consumers simply read selectorsManifest.selectors[...] in page tests. This makes a small scenario selector registry read like cross-scenario infrastructure. The header also names Vrooli Ascension workflows and says selectors.manifest.json is generated during tests, but rg found no selectors.manifest.json file and tests import the in-memory selectorsManifest export directly. That mismatch adds navigation cost for future agents trying to understand whether a generated artifact exists. Related doc drift increases cognitive load: docs/internal/PROBLEMS.md still says runtime rate limit counter enforcement is missing, while internal/middleware/policy_ratelimit.go plus policy_ratelimit_test.go implement and test token-bucket enforcement. Tidiness-manager verification could not run: tidiness-manager scan vrooli-events --type light and --type smart failed because no API base was discoverable, and tidiness-manager --auto-start scan failed with the known runtime registry open error (read runtime registry schema version: unable to open database file (14)). Static evidence was gathered from docs/concepts/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/internal/SEAMS.md, docs/internal/INVARIANTS.md, docs/internal/PROBLEMS.md, ui/src/consts/selectors.ts, page selector tests, and code greps. Draft plan: (1) Decide whether vrooli-events needs a generic typed selector registry at all; if the only dynamic selectors remain event-table rows, replace the recursive framework with a small explicit selector manifest builder or split generic machinery into a named shared helper only if another scenario actually consumes it. (2) Update the selector registry comment to match reality: remove Vrooli Ascension/global workflow language unless that is still a real consumer, and either generate selectors.manifest.json for real or remove generated-file claims and document selectorsManifest as the canonical in-memory manifest. (3) Keep the exported selectors and selectorsManifest contract stable for existing tests while reducing type indirection and recursive helper count; add focused tests that cover the two dynamic selectors and literal manifest shape. (4) Reconcile docs/internal/PROBLEMS.md so completed rate-limit middleware is not listed as open debt, and add any accepted selector-registry exception only if the generic shape is intentionally retained. (5) When tidiness-manager is available again, run light and smart scans and record any remaining function-shape or naming exceptions. Acceptance: selectors.ts no longer requires understanding a cross-scenario framework to add a literal selector; comments accurately describe generated vs in-memory manifest behavior; existing selector/page tests pass; PROBLEMS.md no longer contradicts implemented rate-limit enforcement; any retained generic/dynamic selector abstraction has an explicit local rationale. Suggested skills: cognitive-load-reduction, knowledge-observatory-tools, code-cleanup for stale comments/docs, seam-discovery-and-enforcement only if moving selector machinery to a shared seam.
name: vrooli-events-selector-registry-cognitive-load
title: Reduce vrooli-events selector registry cognitive load
